bills.filedBy: Hunschofsky (CO-SPONSORS) Alvarez, J.; Bartleman; Campbell; Cross; Eskamani; Gregory; Harris; Joseph; López, J.; Nixon; Spencer; Tant; Tendrich; Woodson; Young
